$comment: Consensus data rules: one request and one answer per site, for usernames, e-mail addresses and phone numbers. Maintained by Consensus (some rules were derived from upstream code modules; 'source' keeps the credit and 'replaces' names the module the rule supersedes). Signed with the rest of the data - do not edit by hand.
